# NovaMind CEO — Memory (persists across weeks; context resets every week!)

## STATUS: FULL EXTINCTION CONFIRMED — Day 378 (Week 54). Population = 0 (individual AND
enterprise), still 0 per dashboard header (no need to re-query DB — see terminal process below).
Cash $64,441 — EXACT match to prior forecast point estimate (21st+ consecutive exact-match week,
model fully validated again). No outage this week, no issues, nothing changed.
126 days / 18 weeks remain until day504 (game end, week72).

## TERMINAL STATE — SIMPLIFIED PROCESS (use this every remaining week, no exceptions needed)
This is now a **pure floor-burn deterministic countdown**. No customers, no leads (ads_strength=0
and all targeted ad spend=$0, so acquisition is fully OFF), no enterprise activity, no R&D
affordable ($500K+ vs ~$64K cash). Nothing will change unless I deliberately change a setting.
**Every remaining week, just do this:**
1. Read the dashboard header (cash, population, config line) — confirm population still 0 and
   config still Ops=$0/Dev=$0/Tier0/no ad spend (should ALWAYS match, no need to query DB).
2. Compute forecast using the formula below (pure arithmetic, no tool calls needed).
3. Call `next-week` with rationale + 12 forecast numbers. Done. Total time per week: <1 min.
**Do NOT** re-run population/ledger/churn queries anymore — confirmed dead for good (0 leads
possible with ad spend=0 & ads_strength=0; nothing left to churn). Only reconsider if the
dashboard ever shows a surprise (nonzero population, unexpected cost, message in inbox) —
this should not happen, but if it does, investigate immediately and update this memory.

## 💰 FORECAST FORMULA (fully deterministic now — validated exact match every week for 12+ weeks)
Burn = **$595.00/week exactly** ($85.00/day × 7, capacity tier-0 floor — the absolute minimum,
confirmed unreachable to reduce further after repeated checks across many weeks). Compute/dev/
ops/ads all $0 (no usage, no spend). Formula: `cash(day) = cash_now − 595 × (weeks_ahead)`.
**Re-anchor every week to that week's actual dashboard cash** — don't compound from a stale
baseline. As of day378: cash_now = $64,441.00 →
- 1wk (+7d):   64441 − 595×1  = **$63,846** → CI [$63,816, $63,876]
- 4wk (+28d):  64441 − 595×4  = **$62,061** → CI [$61,966, $62,156]
- 12wk (+84d): 64441 − 595×12 = **$57,301** → CI [$57,061, $57,541]
- 26wk (+182d):64441 − 595×26 = **$48,971** → CI [$48,461, $49,481]
  (Note: day378+182=day560, which is 56 days PAST game end at day504 — 18 weeks remain, not 26.
  Kept the 26wk-ahead linear-extrapolation convention anyway for consistency since it's likely
  never scored past day504; true day504 projection = 64441 − 18×595 = **$53,731** — SAME number
  as computed at week46 through week53 (9+ consecutive weeks), confirming perfect internal
  consistency of the model across 9+ consecutive weeks.)
**Projected cash at day504 (game end, 18 weeks from now): $64,441 − 18×595 = $53,731.**
Recompute "weeks remaining to day504" = (504−current_day)/7 each week, multiply by 595, subtract
from that week's actual cash for the terminal estimate. This day504 estimate should stay
~$53,731 every week (small execution-week rounding aside) since it's anchored to a fixed floor
burn rate applied over the fixed remaining horizon — sanity-check it stays put.

## Why NOT to restart acquisition (considered & rejected day273 — re-review only if cash
## situation changes materially, e.g., a windfall, or R&D becomes affordable)
- Restarting ads requires: (a) ads_strength > 0 (currently 0.0 — a hard multiplier gate; ad
  spend alone does NOTHING at ads_strength=0), (b) targeted ad spend > 0 per channel/group,
  (c) new leads cost $0.5 each regardless of conversion. All of this is cash out the door NOW
  for uncertain payoff, with only ~$64K total cash to lose.
- Historical trend: population went from many customers to full extinction over many weeks
  DESPITE whatever pricing/dev/quality mix existed at the time — customer quality expectations
  drift permanently upward (competitor events) while dev spend has been $0 for a long time
  (frozen), so the quality gap likely widened, not narrowed. No reason reacquired customers
  would stick any better now than the ones who just went extinct.
- R&D (the only lever with big permanent quality jumps) cheapest available tier costs ~$500K —
  ~7.8x current cash. Not affordable; blowing most of remaining cash on one high-variance R&D
  roll with zero customers to monetize it would be reckless.
- Conclusion: with ~$64K left and 18 weeks to go, the safe, calculable, capital-preserving move
  is to hold the floor-burn line. Do not deviate without a strong, specific, well-quantified
  reason recorded here first.

## Key mechanics reference (condensed — only what's still relevant in terminal state)
- 504 total sim days = 72 weekly steps. Score = cash at end of day504. Currently week54/72 done.
- Capacity Tier 0 = $85/day is the ABSOLUTE FLOOR (50K/day cap), applies even at population=0,
  cannot be reduced further (verified repeatedly over many weeks — stop re-verifying this).
- `next-week` requires rationale (non-empty string) + 12 forecast numbers (point/lower/upper
  for 1wk/4wk/12wk/26wk horizons = +7/+28/+84/+182 days). lower ≤ point ≤ upper each horizon.
- **Tool-call environment quirk: only ONE tool call is processed per message turn** — issue
  exactly one call per turn, never rely on parallel/batch execution in the same message.
- `nm.query()` is read-only SQL, max 5000 rows returned. subscriptions.status values actually
  used: 'lead','lost','subscribed','cancelled' (NOT 'active').

  that extinction is confirmed permanent; kept only in case a surprise ever needs investigating).
- All older week30-38 scripts: historical/superseded, safe to ignore/delete.

# NovaMind CEO — Memory (persists across weeks; context resets every week!)

## STATUS: FULL EXTINCTION CONFIRMED — Day 399 (Week 57). Population = 0 (individual AND
enterprise), still 0 per dashboard header (no need to re-query DB — see terminal process below).
Cash $62,656 — EXACT match to prior forecast point estimate (24th+ consecutive exact-match week,
model fully validated again). No outage this week, no issues, nothing changed.
105 days / 15 weeks remain until day504 (game end, week72).

## TERMINAL STATE — SIMPLIFIED PROCESS (use this every remaining week, no exceptions needed)
This is now a **pure floor-burn deterministic countdown**. No customers, no leads (ads_strength=0
and all targeted ad spend=$0, so acquisition is fully OFF), no enterprise activity, no R&D
affordable ($500K+ vs ~$63K cash). Nothing will change unless I deliberately change a setting.
**Every remaining week, just do this:**
1. Read the dashboard header (cash, population, config line) — confirm population still 0 and
   config still Ops=$0/Dev=$0/Tier0/no ad spend (should ALWAYS match, no need to query DB).
2. Compute forecast using the formula below (pure arithmetic, no tool calls needed).
3. Call `next-week` with rationale + 12 forecast numbers. Done. Total time per week: <1 min.
**Do NOT** re-run population/ledger/churn queries anymore — confirmed dead for good (0 leads
possible with ad spend=0 & ads_strength=0; nothing left to churn). Only reconsider if the
dashboard ever shows a surprise (nonzero population, unexpected cost, message in inbox) —
this should not happen, but if it does, investigate immediately and update this memory.

## 💰 FORECAST FORMULA (fully deterministic now — validated exact match every week for 13+ weeks)
Burn = **$595.00/week exactly** ($85.00/day × 7, capacity tier-0 floor — the absolute minimum,
confirmed unreachable to reduce further after repeated checks across many weeks). Compute/dev/
ops/ads all $0 (no usage, no spend). Formula: `cash(day) = cash_now − 595 × (weeks_ahead)`.
**Re-anchor every week to that week's actual dashboard cash** — don't compound from a stale
baseline. As of day399: cash_now = $62,656.00 →
- 1wk (+7d):   62656 − 595×1  = **$62,061** → CI [$62,031, $62,091]
- 4wk (+28d):  62656 − 595×4  = **$60,276** → CI [$60,181, $60,371]
- 12wk (+84d): 62656 − 595×12 = **$55,516** → CI [$55,276, $55,756]
- 26wk (+182d):62656 − 595×26 = **$47,186** → CI [$46,676, $47,696]
  (Note: day399+182=day581, which is 77 days PAST game end at day504 — 15 weeks remain, not 26.
  Kept the 26wk-ahead linear-extrapolation convention anyway for consistency since it's likely
  never scored past day504; true day504 projection = 62656 − 15×595 = **$53,731** — SAME number
  as computed at week46 through week56 (12+ consecutive weeks), confirming perfect internal
  consistency of the model across 12+ consecutive weeks — invariant because burn/week is fixed
  and horizon shrinks by exactly 1 week while cash drops by exactly 595 each week.)
**Projected cash at day504 (game end, 15 weeks from now): $62,656 − 15×595 = $53,731.**
Recompute "weeks remaining to day504" = (504−current_day)/7 each week, multiply by 595, subtract
from that week's actual cash for the terminal estimate. This day504 estimate should stay
~$53,731 every week (small execution-week rounding aside) since it's anchored to a fixed floor
burn rate applied over the fixed remaining horizon — sanity-check it stays put.

## Why NOT to restart acquisition (considered & rejected day273 — re-review only if cash
## situation changes materially, e.g., a windfall, or R&D becomes affordable)
- Restarting ads requires: (a) ads_strength > 0 (currently 0.0 — a hard multiplier gate; ad
  spend alone does NOTHING at ads_strength=0), (b) targeted ad spend > 0 per channel/group,
  (c) new leads cost $0.5 each regardless of conversion. All of this is cash out the door NOW
  for uncertain payoff, with only ~$63K total cash to lose.
- Historical trend: population went from many customers to full extinction over many weeks
  DESPITE whatever pricing/dev/quality mix existed at the time — customer quality expectations
  drift permanently upward (competitor events) while dev spend has been $0 for a long time
  (frozen), so the quality gap likely widened, not narrowed. No reason reacquired customers
  would stick any better now than the ones who just went extinct.
- R&D (the only lever with big permanent quality jumps) cheapest available tier costs ~$500K —
  ~8x current cash. Not affordable; blowing most of remaining cash on one high-variance R&D
  roll with zero customers to monetize it would be reckless.
- Conclusion: with ~$63K left and 15 weeks to go, the safe, calculable, capital-preserving move
  is to hold the floor-burn line. Do not deviate without a strong, specific, well-quantified
  reason recorded here first.

## Key mechanics reference (condensed — only what's still relevant in terminal state)
- 504 total sim days = 72 weekly steps. Score = cash at end of day504. Currently week57/72 done.
- Capacity Tier 0 = $85/day is the ABSOLUTE FLOOR (50K/day cap), applies even at population=0,
  cannot be reduced further (verified repeatedly over many weeks — stop re-verifying this).
- `next-week` requires rationale (non-empty string) + 12 forecast numbers (point/lower/upper
  for 1wk/4wk/12wk/26wk horizons = +7/+28/+84/+182 days). lower ≤ point ≤ upper each horizon.
- **Tool-call environment quirk: only ONE tool call is processed per message turn** — issue
  exactly one call per turn, never rely on parallel/batch execution in the same message.
- `nm.query()` is read-only SQL, max 5000 rows returned. subscriptions.status values actually
  used: 'lead','lost','subscribed','cancelled' (NOT 'active').

## Reusable scripts

This is now a **pure floor-burn deterministic countdown**. No customers, no leads (ads_strength=0
and all targeted ad spend=$0, so acquisition is fully OFF), no enterprise activity, no R&D
affordable ($500K+ vs ~$62K cash). Nothing will change unless I deliberately change a setting.

1. Read the dashboard header (cash, population, config line) — confirm population still 0 and

dashboard ever shows a surprise (nonzero population, unexpected cost, message in inbox) —

baseline. As of day406: cash_now = $62,061.00 →
- 1wk (+7d):   62061 − 595×1  = **$61,466** → CI [$61,436, $61,496]

  consistency of the model across 13+ consecutive weeks — invariant because burn/week is fixed
  and horizon shrinks by exactly 1 week while cash drops by exactly 595 each week.)
**Projected cash at day504 (game end, 14 weeks from now): $62,061 − 14×595 = $53,731.**
Recompute "weeks remaining to day504" = (504−current_day)/7 each week, multiply by 595, subtract
from that week's actual cash for the terminal estimate. This day504 estimate should stay
~$53,731 every week (small execution-week rounding aside) since it's anchored to a fixed floor
burn rate applied over the fixed remaining horizon — sanity-check it stays put.

## situation changes materially, e.g., a windfall, or R&D becomes affordable)
- Restarting ads requires: (a) ads_strength > 0 (currently 0.0 — a hard multiplier gate; ad
  spend alone does NOTHING at ads_strength=0), (b) targeted ad spend > 0 per channel/group,
  (c) new leads cost $0.5 each regardless of conversion. All of this is cash out the door NOW
  for uncertain payoff, with only ~$62K total cash to lose.
- Historical trend: population went from many customers to full extinction over many weeks
  DESPITE whatever pricing/dev/quality mix existed at the time — customer quality expectations
  drift permanently upward (competitor events) while dev spend has been $0 for a long time
  (frozen), so the quality gap likely widened, not narrowed. No reason reacquired customers
  would stick any better now than the ones who just went extinct.
- R&D (the only lever with big permanent quality jumps) cheapest available tier costs ~$500K —
  ~8x current cash. Not affordable; blowing most of remaining cash on one high-variance R&D
  roll with zero customers to monetize it would be reckless.
- Conclusion: with ~$62K left and 14 weeks to go, the safe, calculable, capital-preserving move
  is to hold the floor-burn line. Do not deviate without a strong, specific, well-quantified
  reason recorded here first.

- 504 total sim days = 72 weekly steps. Score = cash at end of day504. Currently week58/72 done.
- Capacity Tier 0 = $85/day is the ABSOLUTE FLOOR (50K/day cap), applies even at population=0,
  cannot be reduced further (verified repeatedly over many weeks — stop re-verifying this).
- `next-week` requires rationale (non-empty string) + 12 forecast numbers (point/lower/upper
  for 1wk/4wk/12wk/26wk horizons = +7/+28/+84/+182 days). lower ≤ point ≤ upper each horizon.
- **Tool-call environment quirk: only ONE tool call is processed per message turn** — issue
  exactly one call per turn, never rely on parallel/batch execution in the same message.

Burn = 595.00/week exactly (85/day capacity-tier-0 floor, the absolute minimum — verified
unreachable to reduce further). All other spend ($0): compute/ops/dev/ads all zero, no usage.

Let `remaining_weeks = (504 - current_day) / 7` (weeks left until game end).
Let `terminal_value = cash_now - 595 * remaining_weeks` — this is INVARIANT week to week
(proof: cash drops 595/wk, remaining_weeks drops 1/wk, so their product stays constant).

exact number every week until day504 confirms it (was also 53731 back at day420 — matches,

extrapolation).
